name: olegvg-skills
description: Grouped personal skills for agent workflows: three-layer KB management and portable development workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Grouped skills for KB management and core development
interface.longDescription: Umbrella package for grouped agent skills. The kb-for-agents group builds, queries, refreshes, records decisions, and maintains a three-layer knowledge base inside a codebase or notes corpus. The core-dev group covers behavior-preserving code cleanup, mobile test environments, and deep code reviews, including audits of implicit state machines.
defaultPrompt: Use $olegvg-skills:kb-build to build a KB for this codebase.
Use $olegvg-skills:kb-query to query the project knowledge base.
Use $olegvg-skills:simplify-code to simplify the current diff without changing behavior.
